tools.name: inventory_db_get_spare_part
tools.description: Retrieve the criticality-enriched spare part master record from dim_spare_part, including criticality class, min/max stock, and lead time.

tools.name: inventory_db_query_consumption_history
tools.description: Run an analytical query against fact_consumption for a material/plant over a date range, returning consumed quantity, date, and work order reference per record, for demand forecasting.

tools.name: inventory_db_get_stock_snapshot
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent daily stock snapshot (fact_stock_snapshot) for a material/plant, including on-hand quantity and snapshot date. This is an analytical, potentially up-to-24-hour-stale copy; cross-check against the live SAP MM stock read for any material flagged at stock-out risk.

tools.name: inventory_db_log_ai_recommendation
tools.description: Write an AI-generated stocking or procurement recommendation to fact_ai_spare_recommendation for audit trail purposes. This is the only write action this connector supports; it cannot write to actual on-hand stock quantities, which remain owned by SAP MM/WMS as system of record.
